subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be permanently denied patch access to legacy ownerless session rows, leaving those rows operator-only?
rationale: Fail-closed behavior protects the ownership boundary, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for any plugin workflow that previously patched ownerless rows.

options.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
options.body: Require exact persisted owner equality for plugin-runtime mutations and reserve ownerless-row recovery for operator clients.

options.title: Add controlled ownership migration
options.body: Provide an operator or doctor-owned adoption path before enforcing the ownerless-row restriction.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
recommendation.body: Require exact persisted owner equality for plugin-runtime mutations and reserve ownerless-row recovery for operator clients.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the existing ownership invariant and has the strongest recent gateway session handler history.
